notes.title: Accesability & Assist Mode
notes.notes:
[b]Hey there![/b]

v1.2 is ready!

[b]Accessibility features have been added[/b], trying to make the game as customizable as possible. Please, in case you need something to be added, write me at taarobravo@gmail.com


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/37ad8384231b62c9de9be03bad0710a02d43c134.gif[/img]

I also added an [b]Assist Mode[/b]. 
Farewell is going to be a game where the main focus will be on the story and combat, but I wouldn't want someone who wants to play the experience to be blocked by the combat. With this intention, I made it possible to modify the damage and cooldowns values on allies and enemies. Ideally, you shouldn't touch them, but if at some point you're having a bad time feel free to change them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/b6c5627c67ed8b3926d099bc8f2d2fa50eff9df3.gif[/img]

The next version, 1.3, will be the [b]Combat Update[/b], which I plan to be quite large. I hope to have it by the end of the month or the beginning of the next month. 

Remember to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/TaaroBravo]Twitter [/url]where I am everyday!
Thank you very much as always!

notes.title: Demo on June
notes.notes:
[b]Hi there![/b]

I hope you are having a good start of the month.

I wanted to tell you that after 5 months of hard work I finished the demo of [b]Farewell[/b]. These months were of a lot of work but especially the last 30 days were exhausting, working between 10 and 12 hours a day to have the demo ready.

About a month ago the announcement of the [b]Tiny Teams Festival[/b] to be held in August of this year came out, but the inscriptions were until June 11. I was very excited because I know it is an important festival, but I did not see it possible to have the demo ready with all the work ahead of me. That's what I thought for a couple of days, until I finished a whole new section in two days.

I realized that, with an intense rhythm, I could manage to register for the festival, and so I did. That goal achieved not only the inscription, but also to have the demo for June, which was the month that the first of January had set as deadline. 

I don't know if I will finally enter the festival, that depends on the judges, but I am very happy to be able to tell you that I was able to reach the dates, and I want to launch it and listen to your opinions.

I'm still making the final touches and doing a lot of playtesting to give you the best experience, but [b]before the end of June[/b] it will be ready :)

As always, thank you very much for everything.

Best,

Taaro.

notes.title: New Combat System and release date of the Demo
notes.notes:
Hey there!

April passed and it's been a month since this page is up. Thanks to everyone for the support, as always. 
Today I'm going to talk about what I've been working on with combat and then an estimated demo date.

[h2][b]Combat Systems[/b][/h2]
During april, with the site ready, I was testing different types of combat. 
I did the design of dozens of combats, but finally I decided to develop 3. The idea was to test:
[list]
[*] How fun it was
[*] How hard it was to develop
[*] If it felt right for my kind of game.
[/list]

First, Undertale style combat with an emotion system like in Omori. I leave some images here of what I developed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/0e4830288ff0c540a5b707dffac8fc49f08e4a2d.gif[/img]

I like the result and feel it would be interesting, but not for the type of game I'm making, so I discarded that approach.

The second test was to make a JRPG but in 2.5D in the style of Octopath traveler, but it turned out to be very complex to maintain and was archived.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/fb4d41226ad3fd8d1ab0b787246bece4b76eeae9.png[/img]

The third test was the one I'm currently developing: a JRPG with a mechanic of aiming when attacking and with emotions that affect the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/cb780a7fe4611003fc615766ece102cf44c1f376.gif[/img]

I still have a couple of things left, but I'm excited and hope you can try it out soon to hear your feedback.

[b][h2]Demo Date:[/h2][/b]
I've been estimating, the remaining things I have to do and a playtesting (if you are interested in participating, please write me at [url=taarobravo@gmail.com]taarobravo@gmail.com[/url]). The estimated date would be in [b]early July[/b]. I'm dedicating between 8 and 10 hours a day to it so I hope I can publish it soon.

[b][h2]Bonus:[/h2][/b]
Currently, the new Steam Capsule is being worked on. Soon the page will be updated with that and the new combat :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046926/e81c5c930c74871baaa9e854950ee18975d0e92d.png[/img]

Thank you very much for reading to the end.

Best.
Taaro.
